REST breaking changes (0)

Downstream breaking changes (1)

highGenerated SDK method moves between clients

Moving released Go methods between generated clients can break imports, client construction, and method calls while preserving the HTTP contract.

Evidence:

  • Expanding a clientLocation exclusion from C# to C# and Go can move existing Go methods between generated clients.
  • Changed TypeSpec source: specification/recoveryservicesbackup/resource-manager/Microsoft.RecoveryServices/RecoveryServicesBackup/back-compatible.tsp.

Azure Guidelines (2)

mediumReplaced preview remains in the version enum

Gap: The version enum adds 2026-02-01 while retaining 2026-01-31-preview, contrary to the stable-after-preview guidance.

Expected

For any type with an `@added(p)` decorator, delete the type. Remove the replaced preview version from the version enum.

Guidance: Adding a Stable Version when the Last Version was Preview — Retained authoritative evidence
